name: V23→V24 temporary-storage migration integration
architecture_source: Mavenu AI SaaS Platform Development Architecture V4 p.43, V23 reversible schema migrations + V24 validated record/event persistence
objective: Integrate V23 schema migrator into V24 temporary persistence initialization without changing V9 runtime, customer access, or synthetic dataset
required_proof: Combined migration + transaction regression, rollback/reopen evidence, and unsigned human review packet

startup_policies.v0_empty: upgrade 0→1 then 1→2 (two separately committed adjacent migrations)
startup_policies.v1_with_any_data: reject without modifying data or version
startup_policies.v2_existing: reject bootstrap; use existing commit/replay path without schema mutation
startup_policies.migration_failure: adjacent DDL step rolls back, marker and physical schema unchanged; V0→V2 whole request NOT atomic

risks: V23 migration runner supports disposable SQLite only and is not a production deployment migration.
Migration from version 0 to 2 commits each adjacent version separately; failure in 1→2 may leave a valid empty version-1 schema.
V24.1 bootstrap only resumes an empty version-1 schema; human/costumer records must never be silently deleted or migrated.
Synthetic ledger and SHA-256 receipt provide deterministic test integrity, not real authentication, audit trust, power-loss or backup certification.
Existing V24 contract remains a historical record: original V24 had no V23 migration; this V24.1 amendment controls new bootstrap semantics.
Formal human approval, customer source rights, production tenancy and release remain pending.
